note: Docket, caption, and counsel are the worker expressions. Caption is from litigation_radar.py, case-sensitive, and uses capturing groups. Counsel is from competition_radar.py, compiled there with re.I, and uses Unicode \w. Both docket expressions use the i flag. The flags object is how each row is compared to Python re. The short docket is a separate check and does not replace the worker's any-digit flag. REGEX_FINDALL returns the full match, the same span as finditer group(0), not the capturing groups. REGEX_REPLACE can insert group 1 with \1, so a hashtag caller can drop the # mark that way. \uXXXX and \UXXXXXXXX are one character, including inside a class. Python re reads those escapes in the pattern; this dialect does too.
